# Random genomes over the experimental hardware (hw_type 3) instruction
# library, traced by the C++ reference (cbuild/work/avida -a, analyze
# LOAD_SEQUENCE... + TRACE trace_out/ 0 0 <random>, resources at their
# update-0 levels) with the tests/fixtures/exp_env/ft1 config (MULTI_ABSORB_TYPE 2, PRED_PREY_SWITCH 1, forage targets 0, 1, 3)
# and the instruction set given per batch (INSTSET diff:hw_type=3).
# SEQ <sequence> <fnv1a64 of the trace> <trace length in bytes>
# Each batch was one reference run, so one world RNG and one test CPU carry
# over from genome to genome as in cAnalyze::CommandTrace. Random batches
# hold nop-A..nop-H (nop-A..nop-P in the 16-nop batches) plus up to 54 other
# instructions, 100-instruction genomes drawn uniformly. Left out of them:
# die (the reference segfaults in a test CPU) and deposit-resource /
# nop-deposit-resource (a negative register indexes GetRBins() out of
# bounds, undefined in C++, Err in Rust); the last batch runs those two on
# hand-written genomes that keep the index in range.
# The last two batches trace the ancestors of the hw_type 3 consistency
# tests (lookAhead_v1 and avatars-pred_look *.org with their instruction
# set; avatars blank-repro.org with its own) as letter sequences.
BATCH fixed
